segments.text: This is Crypto Bot: a calm autopilot for Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana that trades on Solana and can record every decision on-chain.

Retail trading bots fail people in three ways: they overtrade, their track records can't be checked, and they want your keys. We built seven intraday strategies first. Backtested on Binance history, none had an edge after fees.
So Crypto Bot does the opposite: one slow decision a day. Price above its moving averages? Hold more of the coin. Below them? Wait in dollars.
After the daily close, the bot computes the signal, plans the rebalance, and swaps through Jupiter straight from the user's own wallet.
Each decision can be written to Solana with the Memo program before any order. Block time can't be backdated, so anyone can check it. Devnet for now.
Backtested on Bitcoin and Ethereum since twenty eighteen, with fees: forty-two percent a year, versus twenty-three for buy and hold, at about half the drawdown. A backtest, not a promise.
Solana makes it practical: Jupiter quoted about four cents to buy and sell five hundred dollars of Bitcoin, versus about a dollar on an exchange.
Starting takes a click and a confirmation. The app explains every trade in plain words, in English, Russian and Armenian.
It's non-custodial, with a risk-free simulation on live Jupiter quotes, auto-protection, and a hundred seventy-nine automated tests.
Next: a mainnet proof journal with a public verifier, then an on-chain vault, then a marketplace of strategies ranked by proven results.
Crypto Bot: one slow decision a day, from your own wallet, on Solana. Trend-following you can verify. Thank you.
